card.name: Population-wide averages and group statistics
card.fires_on: The last word of a phrase describing a whole population or country, such as waistline, median age, average age or elevation, usually in news or statistics text.

modes.label: Average of a population
modes.description: Words like age or intensity after median or average, describing a group as a whole.

modes.label: Nation-level traits
modes.description: Words describing a country or nation's body, size or terrain in general.
modes.example: Most of the country has an<< elevation>> of fewer than 200 m

modes.label: Obesity and weight of Americans
modes.description: Word endings in reports on the weight of a whole population.
modes.example: F as in Fat", that's the name of a new report on the future of America's waist<<line>>.

card.writes: It pushes toward words meaning shared or as a whole, such as collectively, collective and together.
card.plain: It marks words that describe a whole group or country at once, such as average age or national waistline.
